subject: SIG initiation — scope confirmation & next steps
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@healthlane.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-08T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG initiation — scope confirmation & next steps

Hi Oliver — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and a handful of clarifying asks so we can kick off the SIG/CAIQ process with the right scope.

Recap from our call
- HealthLane is evaluating Redwood for chat & structured extraction on clinical workflows; primary traffic will be production patient data (PHI) for clinical routing use cases.
- You mentioned an upcoming SOC 2 Type II assessment and that GDPR applies for EU customer data.

Clarifying questions / asks (short list)
1) SOC 2 status: can you confirm whether the Type II is scheduled or completed? If scheduled, expected date? (helps us provide interim evidence)
2) Regulatory scope: you confirmed HIPAA applies — please confirm PHI will be sent to production endpoints only and whether any de-identified data will be used in staging.
3) Data residency: do you require EU-hosted inference or data residency guarantees for any subset of users?
4) Questionnaire scope: would you like us to complete SIG (vanilla), CAIQ, or your custom vendor questionnaire? If custom, please upload the doc.
5) Procurement/contact: please share the procurement or contracts contact to include on next steps and the preferred timeline for returning the prefill (we typically ask for 5–7 business days).
6) SSO / auth: do you prefer SAML2.0 or OIDC for integration (helps us prep the security diagram).

Attachments: I’ve attached a preliminary SIG-prefill that covers most common asks plus a short Redwood SOC 2 summary to accelerate review.

Proposed next steps
- We’ll wait for your scope confirmation (prod-only vs prod+staging) and procurement contact.
- Once you confirm, we’ll send a link to a DocuSign DPA + updated prefill and create a shared folder for evidence exchange.
- If it helps, we can schedule a 30-min technical follow-up early next week to walk SSO and key controls with your security team.

Please feel free to reply inline to the questions above or ping me with a preferred time for the technical call.

Thanks — looking forward to progressing this.

—
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments:

- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (attachment stub)
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@healthlane.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@healthlane.com>, Asha Mehta <asha.mehta@healthlane.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T19:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG initiation — scope confirmation & next steps

Hi Naomi — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers below, and I copied procurement & contracts to start the contracting thread.

1) SOC 2: We are not yet Type II; the external audit is scheduled for the week of 2026-11-09. We can provide our SOC 2 Type I report (2026Q2) and an internal controls matrix in the meantime.
2) HIPAA / PHI: Yes, HIPAA applies. Confirmed: only production endpoints will receive PHI. Staging is anonymized/de-identified data only.
3) Data residency: No hard EU residency requirement today, but GDPR obligations apply for EU-subject data; we may request EU hosting later in the contract cycle.
4) Questionnaire: SIG prefill is perfect to start. If we find gaps, we’ll follow up with a short custom questionnaire (I’ll upload if needed).
5) Procurement: procurement@healthlane.com is the right inbox; Asha Mehta (cc’d) is our contracts lead. We aim to return the completed prefill by EOD 2026-09-13.
6) SSO: We prefer SAML 2.0 for now (IdP: Okta). Can you include a short section in the prefill on certificate rotation / signing cert expiry windows?

A couple of asks from our side
- Can you confirm Redwood’s breach notification SLA (time-to-notify) and whether you provide encrypted snapshots for audit?
- Please include the primary Redwood contact for evidence uploads (SFTP/Drive) and the expected format for cryptographic proofs.

We’ll aim to get the prefill back by 9/13. If you’ve got a short technical slot tomorrow morning (PST) for SSO questions, Asha can join.

Thanks,
Oliver
Head of Security Programs, HealthLane
oliver.grant@healthlane.com | +1 (617) 555-6643

Subject: Re: SIG initiation — scope confirmation & next steps

Thanks Oliver — this is great and helpful. Asha / procurement — welcome, and thanks for jumping in.

Quick answers to your asks and next steps: 
- SOC 2 evidence: we’ll attach our Type I report and a control matrix to the evidence folder; our SOC 2 Type II audit is on our roadmap and we’ll share auditor engagement dates where available.
- Breach notification SLA: Redwood’s standard is initial customer notification within 72 hours of detection; we’ll include the SLA excerpt in the evidence bundle.
- Encrypted snapshots: we can provide encrypted backups for auditor review — we’ll note the format and rotation policy in the evidence pack.
- SSO: Redwood supports SAML 2.0 and OIDC. I’ve added a short SSO details section to the updated prefill (see attached SIG-prefill-updated.xlsx) that includes cert rotation cadence (recommended 90 days) and where to find metadata endpoints.

Proposed next steps (concrete)
1) Redwood will add procurement@healthlane.com and Asha to the HubSpot deal and send a DocuSign DPA + the updated SIG prefill today. (I’ll create the folder for evidence exchange once the DPA is routed.)
2) HealthLane to return the completed prefill by 2026-09-13; if you need more time, tell us and we’ll adjust the timeline.
3) Let’s schedule a 30-min technical sync to walk SSO and evidence delivery — I’m available 2026-09-10 09:00–11:00 PST and 2026-09-10 14:00–16:00 PST. Please pick a slot that works for Asha and Oliver.

Attachments included:
- SIG-prefill-updated.xlsx (attachment stub)
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (attachment stub)

If Asha / procurement prefer a different intake form or a vendor portal upload, we’ll follow your preferred process.
